title: Obstructions to $k$-colouring $H$-free graphs
summary: A graph is $H$-free if it has no induced subgraph isomorphic to $H$. In 2020, Chudnovsky, Goedgebeur, Schaudt, and Zhong characterized all graphs $H$ such that there are only finitely many minimal obstructions to $3$-colouring $H$-free graphs. In general, the minimal obstructions to $k$-colouring $H$-free graphs are the $(k+1)$-vertex-critical $H$-free graphs, those are, the $H$-free graphs $G$ with $χ(G)=k+1$ but $χ(G-v)=k$ for every vertex in $G$.
